inlines.v: BROWN-SPAR, noun Pearl spar, or siderocalcite. BROWN'-STUDY, noun [brown and study.] Gloomy study; dull thoughtfulness; meditation directed to no certain object. BROWN'-WORT, noun [brown and wort.] A plant, prunella. 1. A species of Scrophularia, the vernalis, or yellow figwort, with brown stalks.
